item.title: Midterm Eve: the stage is set for Tuesday's elections
item.description:
The Pour Over's Midterm Eve edition sets the stage for Tuesday's midterm elections. As the campaign season's final day arrives, the newsletter rounds up where things stand heading into voting day — the races to watch, the stakes as each side frames them, and what the results could mean for the balance of power in Washington.

It's the calm-before-the-storm edition: a last, clear-eyed look at the map before the votes are counted and the spin begins.

Sources

  • The Pour Over: Midterm Eve

item.title: Everything you've got wrong about daylight saving time
item.description:
With clocks falling back this weekend, The Pour Over takes on the myths around daylight saving time — what it actually does, why it exists, and what people commonly get wrong about it. The piece untangles the history and the health and safety debates that resurface every spring and fall.

It's a timely explainer for the annual ritual: less about the one-hour shift itself, and more about why the argument over permanent daylight saving (or permanent standard time) never seems to settle.

Sources

  • The Pour Over: Everything You’ve Got Wrong About Daylight Saving Time
